title: 1999 AHSME Problem 2
statement: Which one of the following statements is false?

answerChoices.label: A
answerChoices.text:
All equilateral triangles are congruent to each
other.

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text: All equilateral triangles are regular polygons.

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: All equilateral triangles are similar to each other.

solutions.text:
Equilateral triangles with side lengths \(1\) and \(2\) have the same shape but different sizes, so they are similar but not congruent. Every equilateral triangle is convex, equiangular (all angles \(60^\circ\)), and a regular polygon, so the only false statement is that they are all congruent.

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Congruent means the same shape and the same size
Equilateral triangles can have different side lengths
